title: The Latest Crier for Sep 15, 2026
items:
Major Day: Explore. Discover. Declare!

Tuesday, September 22 | 11:00 a.m.--12:30 p.m. | BMW Rooms & Atrium, Maytag Not sure what you want to major or minor in? Major Day is the perfect place to start! First- and second-year students are invited to explore majors and minors, connect with faculty, ask questions, and discover new possibilities. Whether you're still exploring or ready to declare, this is a great opportunity to take the next step toward finding an academic path that fits your interests and goals. 
Come curious, bring your questions, and see where your interests can take you! We hope to see you at Major Day!

Entrepreneur Speaker Series (Sept. 16th 7pm, VSC 180)

Please join the BCOMM Studies department as we welcome Brennan Buckley as our first speaker in the Entrepreneur Speaker Series. 
Brennan Buckely is an accomplished real estate executive, public speaker, and community builder. Mr. Buckley is the founder of Introductions® Real Estate, the industry leader in single point of contact for real estate needs in any market. 

Sept. 16th, 7pm, VSC 180

Zeta Upsilon Tea Times

Join Zeta Upsilon for a night of bracelet making, snacks, and learning more about joining our community service-based sorority! When? Tuesday September 15th from 7:30-8:30pm. Where? Graham Ground Floor Lounge.

Special Event: Storytelling, Curiosity & Connection with Harry Smith

Central College students are invited to a conversation with award-winning journalist and Central College alumnus Harry Smith, joined by marketing professionals from AMA Iowa. The conversation will explore how strong stories are built, why curiosity matters, and how meaningful communication helps people connect across journalism, marketing, and professional life. 

Tuesday, September 15 

11:00–11:45 a.m. 

Recital Hall, Cox-Snow Music Center 

The event is free and open to all Central College faculty and students. 

For more information, please contact Stavros Papakonstantinidis at papakonstantinidiss@central.edu

Fall Intramurals - Flag Football Sign-Ups

Get your team together and register now for Intramural Flag Football. Games will be played on Monday evenings, and all experience levels are welcome! 
Sign up here: Flag Football Intramural Sign-Ups – Fill out form 

Stay tuned for upcoming sign-ups for: Pickleball, Sand Volleyball, Disc Golf, 3x3 Basketball, and Bags (Cornhole)

Language Placement Test

Students who need to take a Language Placement Test for Spanish or German can stop by the Vermeer Science Center (VSC), Room #241 from 11:00am-12:00pm on Tuesday, October 13th. Use the following link to add your name and select a time to confirm your attendance. Contact Dr. Ally Krogstad ( krogstada@central.edu ) or Prof. Oscar Reynaga ( reynagao@central.edu ) if you have any questions.

Make Your Own Trucker Hat

CAB Presents: Make your own trucker hat 
There are a variety of hat colors and different patches, as well as a lotus bar! 

Tuesday, September 15th from 11-1pm in the Maytag Atrium. 

Hope to see you there!!!

Weekly Bible Studies & Discipleship| grow close to God & find friendship :)

Get connected! Study the Bible & build awesome community !! Studies starting week of 9/13. Check out opportunities below: 
-Freshman Girls- Wednesdays @ 6:30 pm, Graham First Floor Lounge 

-Freshman Guys- Fridays @ 7:30 pm, Weller 203 

-Men’s- Mondays @ 7:30 pm, Lower Chapel Prayer Room 

-Women’s- Wednesdays @ 8 pm, Leu West Lounge 

Rather grow one on one?! Email laflinh@central.edu to be paired with a mentor!

The Calm: worship, message, community, & sometimes snacks :)

Feeling overwhelmed? Discouraged? Anxious for the start of the week?! Then start your week off right by joining us for Sunday night worship at THE CALM, 8:30 pm in the Upper Chapel! We will be diving in to the book of Philippians + Acts this semester. Enjoy worship, a message, & community. All are welcome. We would love to see you!

Sessions Available

Student Development welcomes Tori (Fyfe) Toomey and Emily Miranda as campus counselors. Tori is available on Thursday mornings. Emily is available on Tuesday and Sunday evenings. To schedule an appointment with any of the campus counselors, use the self-scheduling link https://bit.ly/3V965Lb or stop in the Student Development office to schedule. Central College Counseling Services supports students in their mental health needs. It is free and open to currently enrolled students.

Check Your Email!!

We are sending out many internships and job opportunities to YOU through Handshake. There are quite a few Summer Internships for 2027 coming out right now and we don't want you to miss them! 
If you have turned off your notifications in Handshake - we can help you turn them back on. 

ALSO!! Look in your "Other" tab if you have that in Outlook. Handshake emails get funneled there too. 

We will try to label the emails with JOB or INTERNSHIP so you know that it is important.
